stage_timings.basis: One bounded reallocation phase occurred after four CREATE_EXISTS collisions; exact elapsed interval not derived.

friction_events.description: Six authority CREATE attempts returned the exact GitHub Contents CREATE_EXISTS signature across two bounded allocation phases.
A pre-authority GitHub claim CREATE was explicitly blocked by safety controls; protocol forbids retry or diversion after this denial.
Direct public exit-page fetch was unavailable; the byte-equivalent gh-pages file was read through the GitHub connector without changing authority.

decision_trace.decision: Create a de-novo v3.30 identity before allocation.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The human invocation declared NUEVO_WORKER=1 and the fresh-launch policy requires beacon-first identity.
decision_trace.action: Created the fresh beacon and froze worker_id plus launch_nonce.

decision_trace.decision: Reallocate instead of closing after the first bounded collision phase.
decision_trace.observable_basis: POOL residency treats claim collisions as nonterminal and the first phase ended with four CREATE_EXISTS outcomes but no authority.
decision_trace.action: Loaded one fresh compact frontier and entered a second bounded allocation phase under the same worker_id.
decision_trace.outcome: Two further collisions occurred before a later claim attempt hit an explicit safety denial.

decision_trace.decision: Stop immediately on explicit pre-authority safety denial.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The claim CREATE returned an explicit safety-control denial before authority existed.
decision_trace.action: Did not retry the denied claim or divert to another candidate; persisted a bounded no-allocation boundary receipt.
decision_trace.outcome: Terminal transport boundary recorded durably with no execution authority and no productive units.

top_time_sinks.note: Six deterministic CREATE_EXISTS collisions consumed most allocation effort before any ownership was obtained.
The explicit safety denial ended the second allocation phase and the worker.

unfinished_debt.item: No project execution authority was acquired. The blocked candidate was not retried and this worker created no recovery debt.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Reduce repeated stale/claimed candidate exposure so a resident pool worker does not spend four deterministic authority attempts on already-existing PINs before useful ownership.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Lower claim-contention waste and faster useful ownership under bursty pool launches.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Expose a stable machine-readable safety-denial classification for blocked GitHub claim CREATE operations.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Cleaner terminal receipts and less prose-dependent transport classification without encouraging retries.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh PROD-01 worker launched correctly, encountered six atomic claim collisions across two bounded allocation phases, then stopped on an explicit pre-authority safety denial. No execution authority or productive unit was claimed; the transport boundary and exit audit were persisted durably.
